checks.detail:
قفل التطبيق

احمِ المركز على هذا الهاتف: يطلب التطبيق بصمتك أو قفل الشاشة عند فتحه، وبعد خمس دقائق من تركه. يمكنك تغيير ذلك من «الحساب».

checks.name: 6c. «تشغيل القفل» asks Android first; with the PIN the lock is on, and it is not offered again
7a. back after longer than the lock waits, Android asks before the page shows
7b. the PIN opens it, and the page is there again

9a. a short absence does not lock
9b. opened afresh, the application asks first
10. «إيقاف القفل» asks Android, and then nothing locks

checks.name: 2b. once the person allows it in Android's settings, links.verified says yes
3a. a page of the site opens in the application, on the address the build opens, with its query
3b. the return of a mailed sign-in link opens in the application and forwards to the sign-in page with its query
3c. a member's WhatsApp link opens in the application
4a. a review link for outside people opens in the browser
4b. the site's root opens in the browser
5. an intent naming a link that climbs out of a page, or another site, opens nothing

notes: assetlinks.json still names the stand-in OWNER_RELEASE_KEY_SHA256: Android cannot verify the links of a release until the owner puts the release key's fingerprint there (a signed release build refuses until then).
